items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 July 2026 4:23pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 23 July 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, but variable 2 to 4 in the southwest of the area, becoming west or northwest 3 or 4 in all waters overnight, then backing west of southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the northeast at first.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, but variable 2 to 4 in the northwest at first, increasing force 6 in the east later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then occasional rain or drizzle later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
